results.overview: Taskmaster was a humorous Spanish television program in which several celebrities underwent various challenges in a humorous tone. It was produced by Secuoya and aired on La 1 between March 9 and April 13, 2018, having been sent to the late-night spot and canceled due to its low audiences, without even recording the final.
